Name: Elnathan
Summary: Elnathan, son of Achbor, was a prince of Jehoiakim's court who was sent to Egypt to seize the prophet Urijah and bring him back to be killed, and who later pleaded with the king not to burn Jeremiah's roll.
KeyStory: Elnathan fetched Urijah from Egypt for Jehoiakim, yet later joined the princes who begged the king not to burn Jeremiah's roll.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Urijah, Son of Shemaiah; Baruch; Ezra
LifeLesson: The same man can carry out a king's cruelty and then plead against it — partial courage is still recorded.
